newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Taleban remove acting deputy foreign minister.
newsitem.headline: Taleban remove acting deputy foreign minister.

text.p: Afghanistan's radical Islamic Taleban rulers have removed one of their main spokesmen, acting Deputy Foreign Minister Sher Mohammed Stanakzai, Taleban sources said on Tuesday.

The sources, contacted in the southern city of Kandahar, said the Taleban's supreme leader Mullah Mohammad Omar had ordered Stanakzai to step down earlier this week, apparently for taking decisions without consulting his superiors.
The sources said Stanakzai had now been appointed acting Deputy Minister for Rehabilitation and Reconstruction, the post he had held previously at Taleban headquarters in Kandahar.
No replacement as acting deputy foreign minister was named.

Stanakzai, 37, a fluent English-speaker, conducted the Taleban's first formal news conference on October 1 a few days after the Sunni Moslem militants swept into Kabul following the withdrawal of forces of ousted president Burhanuddin Rabbani.
